image_description: A white minibus (likely a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter or similar model) parked on a paved surface. The vehicle features a high roof, a row of side windows, and standard van wheels. There is a logo on the front hood and some text/graphics on the rear side window. The background includes a building with scaffolding and some greenery.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof van silhouette, distinct from full-size buses, with proportions consistent with a minibus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, along with multiple side windows indicating passenger seating capacity.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a high roofline. The driver's door is visible at the front, and the sliding track for the passenger door is visible in the mid-body section.
The horizontal seam and handle configuration on the side panel indicate a sliding door mechanism, typical for this class of vehicle.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is taken from a front-three-quarter angle; the rear of the vehicle is completely occluded and outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle is painted white with a small logo on the hood and graphics on the rear side window, fitting the description of company livery.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The wheels are proportional to the vehicle body, appearing to be standard steel rims with hubcaps, consistent with commercial vans.
The length and window configuration suggest a capacity within the 4-10 passenger range, distinguishing it from larger coaches.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The green and white graphic/text on the rearmost side window appears slightly indistinct and lacks sharp character definition, common in AI generations, though not completely illegible.
The logo on the hood is somewhat blurry and lacks the crisp metallic reflection expected of a real emblem, appearing slightly 'painted on' rather than attached.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific make/model consistency and ensure the vehicle is correctly classified as a minibus rather than a cargo van or full-size bus.
To verify the structural integrity of the vehicle's boxy shape and ensure correct spatial separation from the background building and scaffolding.
To check for fusion artifacts where wheels meet the pavement and ensure window frames are topologically sound without melting into the body.
To rigorously analyze the legibility of the text on the side window and the clarity of the hood logo, which showed minor anomalies in the router scan.

focus_areas: Structural symmetry of the vehicle body
Clarity and realism of logos/text decals
Wheel geometry and contact points with the ground
Reflection consistency on windows and paint
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the side window; AI often generates plausible-looking but nonsensical text. Verify if the wheel rims have a consistent circular geometry and if the reflections on the side windows match the environment logically.
